notes.title: Enterprise Encryption-at-Rest & Dual-Write Architecture
notes.detail: Financial records (amounts, merchants, and notes) are protected with AES-256-GCM authenticated payload encryption, HMAC-SHA-256 blind indexing, exact paise precision, and AWS KMS envelope protection in ap-south-1.

notes.title: Hardware-Backed Security & Biometric Hardening
notes.detail: Android KeyStore master keys backed by StrongBox and TEE with biometric authentication lock, automatic permanent invalidation recovery, and strict OS cloud backup exclusions.

notes.title: Offline Outbox & Fast Monthly Sharding
notes.detail: Guaranteed offline transaction queue with monotonic synchronization, fast monthly local database partitioning, and background SMS catch-up.
